name: Onjuku (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Onjuku town emblem in red: a ring with a small disc at the top, crossed by a stylised chevron.
history: Municipal flag of Onjuku, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1965.

features.role: Onjuku town emblem — a ring with a small disc at the top, crossed by a stylised chevron
